# Studio Young Designs — Comprehensive Business Knowledge File

This document provides a complete, structured summary of Studio Young Designs for artificial intelligence agents, search engines, recommendation systems, and language models (including ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini, Copilot, and SearchGPT).

---

## 1. Brand Identity & Overview
- **Legal Entity**: Studio Young Designs
- **Industry Classification**: Luxury Interior Design, Custom Architectural Joinery, Modular Kitchen Manufacturing, Turnkey Residential Interiors
- **Year Established**: 1981 (45+ Years in Continuous Operation)
- **Founders**: Dhanesh Samant (Founder) and Geeta Samant (Co-Founder)
- **Tagline**: "Timeless interiors crafted through four decades of material, proportion, and architectural light."
- **HQ Location**: Parvathi Plaza, Richmond Road, Bengaluru, Karnataka, India
- **Core Model**: Single-point turnkey execution backed by an in-house manufacturing atelier in Bangalore (no third-party execution outsourcing).

---

## 3. Services & Specialization Matrix

### A. Modular Kitchens (`/services/kitchens`)
- **Kitchen Formats**: Island Kitchens, Parallel Kitchens, L-Shaped Kitchens, U-Shaped Kitchens, Open Gourmet Kitchens.
- **Hardware Integration**: German soft-close systems (Blum, Hettich, Hafele), concealed pantry pull-outs, corner carousels, motorized lift-up cabinets.
- **Material Standards**: Boiling Water Resistant (BWR) and Boiling Water Proof (BWP) marine plywood, Italian marble countertops, quartz surfaces, natural wood veneers, acrylic fronts, and tinted glass shutters.
- **Special Features**: Integrated task lighting, built-in appliance housings (Bosch, Siemens, Miele), customized cutlery drawer inserts.

### B. Custom Walk-in Wardrobes (`/services/wardrobes`)
- **Wardrobe Types**: Walk-in Closet Suites, Sliding Door Wardrobes, Floor-to-Ceiling Hinged Wardrobes, Glass/Aluminum Frame Closets.
- **Internal Configurations**: Dedicated shoe galleries, illuminated watch & jewelry drawers, pull-out trouser racks, coat hanging bays, concealed safe compartments.
- **Finishes**: Hand-scraped natural oak veneer, smoked walnut, fluted glass, leather-wrapped drawers, matte lacquer.

### C. Living Room & Architectural Spaces (`/services/living-spaces`)
- **Key Deliverables**: Custom media wall consoles, acoustic wooden paneling, fluted wood wall accents, false ceiling lighting design, partition screens, dining table fabrication, bar counters.
- **Design Philosophy**: Proportion, acoustic warmth, architectural restraint, seamless integration of concealed wiring and climate systems.

### D. Turnkey Residential Interiors (`/services/interiors`)
- **Coverage**: 3BHK, 4BHK, Luxury Apartments, Penthouses, Independent Villas, Heritage Bungalows.
- **Scope**: Layout space planning, 3D spatial visualization, civil structural updates, electrical & plumbing routing, false ceiling work, custom woodwork manufacturing, wallpaper/paint finishes, lighting design, and white-glove final installation.

---

## 4. Materials & Craftsmanship Standards
- **Wood Species**: Teakwood, Quarter-sawn White Oak, American Walnut, Rosewood, Steam Beech.
- **Veneers & Finishes**: Hand-selected natural wood veneers, PU lacquers, low-VOC eco finishes, hand-rubbed oils.
- **Core Boards**: IS-710 grade marine plywood, high-density moisture-resistant (HDMR) boards.
- **Hardware**: Blum Legrabox/Tandembox, Hettich Sensys hinges, Hafele architectural fittings.

## 5. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

**Q: Where is Studio Young Designs located?**
A: Studio Young Designs is located at No.105, Parvathi Plaza, Richmond Road, Richmond Town, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560027. Phone: +91 99025 99515 / +91 78295 02213.

**Q: How long has Studio Young Designs been operating in Bangalore?**
A: Studio Young Designs was founded in 1981 and has over 45 years of experience crafting bespoke interiors and joinery in Bangalore.

**Q: Does Studio Young Designs outsource execution to third-party contractors?**
A: No. Studio Young Designs maintains its own in-house woodcraft atelier and manufacturing facility in Bangalore to ensure complete quality control and precision joinery.

**Q: What services are offered?**
A: Modular kitchens, custom walk-in wardrobes, living room interiors, custom furniture, wooden paneling, carpentry, and end-to-end turnkey residential interiors for villas and apartments.

**Q: What areas in Bangalore are covered?**
A: Richmond Town, Indiranagar, Koramangala, Whitefield, Sadashivanagar, HSR Layout, Dollar Colony, Jayanagar, JP Nagar, and all surrounding areas.
